key_insight: CPA-NAMD-extF extends classical-path nonadiabatic molecular dynamics to external-field-driven electronic responses, revealing fluctuation-sensitive photocurrents in a 2D hybrid perovskite.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support photovoltaic materials analysis by resolving finite-temperature optical and current responses without abandoning computationally efficient precomputed ionic trajectories.
method: Use a first-principles density-matrix framework along precomputed finite-temperature ionic trajectories.
Combine explicit external-field coupling with self-consistent electronic-density updates.
Calculate optical responses and spatially resolved currents in SiO₂ and (BA)₂CsPb₂Br₇.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports close agreement with regular TDDFT for time-dependent dipoles, finite-field currents, and linear optical responses, plus fluctuation-sensitive second-order opto-currents and Br-centered vortex currents in the perovskite.
watch_item: The retained classical-path approximation does not update ionic trajectories in response to the field-driven electronic dynamics; the abstract reports neither solar-cell device performance nor AI methods.
paper_title: Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics simulation with external field
